Pi coding-agent core: runtime composition
|
|-- AgentSessionRuntime [agent-session-runtime.ts]
|   |-- current AgentSession [agent-session.ts]
|   |   |-- Public API and subscriber list
|   |   |   `-- prompt / steer / followUp / abort / compact / navigateTree; state getters
|   |   |-- Run coordination and recovery state
|   |   |   |-- prompt preparation, run bookkeeping, pending messages, settlement
|   |   |   `-- Separate cancellation: compaction, branch summary, retry and bash
|   |   |-- Agent [packages/agent/src/agent.ts]
|   |   |   |-- _state: messages, model, thinkingLevel, tools, streamingMessage
|   |   |   |   `-- isStreaming, pendingToolCalls, errorMessage
|   |   |   |-- steeringQueue / followUpQueue; activeRun abort controller
|   |   |   `-- prompt() / continue() -> agent-loop.ts functions, not owned objects
|   |   |-- SessionManager reference [created or accepted by SDK]
|   |   |   `-- Owns canonical history; Agent.messages is the working projection
|   |   |-- ExtensionRunner [constructed and bound by AgentSession]
|   |   |   |-- -> ResourceLoader supplies extensions and extension runtime
|   |   |   `-- Input, context, tool, provider and boundary hooks
|   |   |-- Tool registries: _baseToolDefinitions / _toolDefinitions / _toolRegistry
|   |   |   |-- Built-ins bound to cwd: read / bash / edit / write by default
|   |   |   |-- Additional built-ins: powershell / grep / find / ls
|   |   |   |-- -> SDK custom tools + ExtensionRunner registrations
|   |   |   `-- wrapRegisteredTools() -> callable tools installed on Agent
|   |   |-- _handleAgentEvent() subscription
|   |   |   |-- -> ExtensionRunner first, then public subscribers
|   |   |   `-- message_end -> SessionManager append ordinary/custom messages
|   |   |-- References -> settingsManager / modelRuntime / resourceLoader below
|   |   |-- CacheWarmer reference: SDK-created; cancelled on disposal
|   |   `-- dispose()
|   |       `-- Abort; invalidate extension contexts; disconnect; cleanup resources
|   |-- AgentSessionServices [agent-session-services.ts; cwd-bound bundle]
|   |   |-- SettingsManager reference
|   |   |   `-- -> Session policies and SDK request transport/retry/timeout options
|   |   |-- ResourceLoader reference
|   |   |   `-- Extensions, skills, templates and other prompt resources
|   |   `-- ModelRuntime reference [model-runtime.ts]
|   |       |-- MutableModels from pi-ai createModels(); provider/model registries
|   |       |-- RuntimeCredentials -> supplied credentials or default AuthStorage
|   |       |-- resolveModel() -> physical model for a virtual selection
|   |       `-- streamSimple() -> authenticated provider request
|   `-- Replacement operations: newSession() / switchSession() / fork()
|       |-- -> abort session and await settlement; emit session_shutdown
|       |-- -> host invalidation callback; session.dispose()
|       `-- -> factory creates replacement; apply(); rebindSession()
|
`-- External callers and assembly [not owned by the runtime]
    |-- CLI main.ts: InteractiveMode / runPrintMode / runRpcMode
    |   `-- -> AgentSessionRuntime; current session API and event subscriptions
    `-- SDK createAgentSession() [sdk.ts]
        |-- Creates or accepts history/settings/model/resource dependencies
        |-- Restored branch + settings + explicit options -> model/thinking/tools
        |-- Constructs Agent, then AgentSession; returns session without CLI runtime
        `-- Installs streamFn -> ModelRuntime; extension provider hooks and settings
